[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017057/88e1738e7b5bfda8fb19d4e53945a6304409d3df.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! I am proudly presenting my new title called Mika's Battle S which is now available on Steam! If you are into 2D Action game with anime style visuals and lots of cutscenes then, this might be the game for you.

[h1]Check it out now:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2817550/Mikas_Battle_S/

Please give this game a try. Your feedback is valuable to me. So, please let me know if you encounter issues.

There is a huge discount on [b]Mega Anime Bundle[/b] for celebrating the release of Mika's Battle S on Steam and if you would like to purchase all of my anime themed games at a huge discount this is your chance.

[h1]Buy Mega Anime Bundle:[/h1] https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/26008/

Thanks to everyone who have been supporting me on Steam! Creating and releasing this game on Steam would have never been possible without your support.

I hope you will enjoy the game. Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik
